name: Kaname
source: A member of Sala's entourage and a DRAGON. The pilot of the mecha Ryu-Shing-Ki Hekiryugo. She has been serving Salamandinay since she was young alongside Naga, who is her close friend. She is also the staff officer of Sala, a discreet person who has the capacity to see the big picture.
translation: A member of Sala's entourage and a DRAGON. The pilot of the mecha Ryu-Shing-Ki Hekiryugo. She has been serving Salamandinay since she was young alongside Naga, who is her close friend. She is also the staff officer of Sala, a discreet person who has the capacity to see the big picture.
